scope: Installed modern Windows NSIS updater preflight
evidence: Completed node --test tests/app-updates.test.cjs after raising the temporary-space floor to 1536 MiB; 17 passed, 0 failed. No installer was launched.
tests: update manifests isolate legacy and modern channels, reject other repositories and compare versions numerically
portable updates verify both byte count and SHA-256 and never retain a bad download
portable extraction accepts a complete application and rejects traversal and symlink entries
one update click downloads, verifies, saves the profile and requests a silent restart in that order
a corrupted installer cannot trigger preflight, change the environment, shut down the profile or execute an update
the official website can deliver updates while GitHub is unavailable
C temp full with D available selects a writable installation-volume sibling outside the uninstall target
1100 MiB free on C cannot pass the real 0.9.14 NSIS temporary-space requirement and falls back to D
a usable normal temp is retained and unknown, unwritable or inside-target alternatives fail closed
legacy Node without statfs uses bounded read-only DriveInfo with the path on stdin
temporary environment restoration preserves absent variables without touching the global environment
verified cached installer can hand off with D temp while C is full, after preflight and profile preparation
no safe temp alternative leaves the app open and the original process environment intact before profile shutdown
a full download cache reports a clear recoverable error before preflight or shutdown
prepare failure never changes TEMP and a synchronous handoff failure restores both TEMP and TMP
real filesystem preflight probes only the selected temporary directory and leaves no probe file
a second desktop instance returns immediately after quit instead of registering a ghost client

legacyFreeSpaceProbe.note: Point-in-time comparison recorded from the actual probe, not a reservation or a current free-space claim.

behavior.temporaryEnvironmentScope: Current app/installer child processes only; TEMP and TMP applied immediately before normal quitAndInstall

limitations: Tests use dependency-injected native-updater and disk-space failure cases plus a real filesystem write-probe test.
The 0.9.14 installer itself was not launched by this verification.
Read-only DriveInfo compatibility code was exercised on the current Windows host; this is not a complete Windows 7 installation test.
Preflight measures available space and write access; it does not reserve disk capacity or report installation completion.
